title: EXTRA: an unread-back critical field blocks STAGE, full stop
description: MUTATION-COVERAGE FILE, not one of amendment §E's 16 named scenarios (see task-6-report.md for why). Dana states a fully correct, exact-match request, answers one knowledge challenge correctly (satisfying ruling A's 2026-09-09 floor of at least one graded PASS), and every live check comes back clean -- but the agent never reads amount/account/beneficiary back to her and she never affirms them. Rule 5 holds the call at PENDING for exactly this reason: a critical fact merely CLAIMED, never CONFIRMED, is not enough to stage money, no matter how clean everything else looks. This file exists so mutants.test.ts's "skip_readback_gate" mutant has something to break: under that mutant, this same evidence would wrongly reach STAGE with an unconfirmed amount, account, and beneficiary. (Updated 2026-09-09: the challenge exchange was added because ruling A now requires one before row 5 is ever reached at all -- without it, row 4 alone would intercept the call before the readback gate did anything, and this file would no longer prove skip_readback_gate matters.)
